claims.text: Applicants must be employed by or have a formal affiliation with a UK-based organisation.
The UK-based organisation must be a university, research organisation, or voluntary sector body.
The affiliation must last for at least the duration of the project.
Unaffiliated individuals are excluded.
Projects led by schools or further education colleges are excluded.
Undergraduates or master's students are excluded.
PhD-fee projects are excluded.
Establishment of academic posts is excluded.
Non-UK-led organisations are excluded, except in exceptional cases.
Overseas hosts are only exceptionally permitted.
The research and related activities should have a clear path to making a difference to people's lives.
